title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the role

We're building out a high-caliber engineering team to support a new platform. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is equally strong in Java and Python , has built and operated microservices on AWS with mature CI/CD pipelines , and has hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production systems. This role starts as a contract with a path to full-time conversion based on performance and fit.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and own backend microservices in Java and Python running on AWS.
  • Architect scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with clean service boundaries and well-designed APIs.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines — automated testing, deployment, observability, rollback strategies.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities (LLMs, model APIs, RAG, embeddings, etc.) into product features and backend services.
  • Operate services end-to-end on AWS — compute, networking, storage, IAM, monitoring, cost management.
  • Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bring relevant advances into the stack.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, ML, and platform teams during ramp-up.

Required qualifications

  • 6–9 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong production experience in both Java and Python (Spring Boot, FastAPI/Flask, or equivalent).
  • Proven track record designing and operating microservices architectures in production.
  • Deep AWS expertise — EKS/ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, SQS/SNS, CloudWatch, IAM.
  • Hands-on CI/CD experience — Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, or similar; IaC with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Practical AI/ML integration experience — working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock), RAG pipelines, vector databases, or embedding-based features in production.
  • Strong fundamentals: distributed systems, API design, testing strategy, observability, security.
  • Working knowledge of current AI/LLM trends — you can speak fluently to what's changed in the last 6 months.

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes / container orchestration in production.
  • Event-driven / streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning workflows.
  • MLOps tooling exposure (MLflow, SageMaker, Bedrock).
  • Performance tuning of JVM and Python services at scale.

title: Dynamometer Technician (Powertrain)
description:
***
This is an immediate backfill for a candidate on leave. There is a potential for extension. Please prep your candidates on the possibility of the contract period going anywhere from 1-6 months. Thank you!

Top skillsets: (Please provide a detailed summary of the candidate's experience in the following skills.)

Top skillsets:

· Dynamoneter

· High voltage experience

· Electric drive unit experience

· Instrumentation experience

· Solid mechanical background

Work Mode: ONSITE M/F - 8 hours a day starting at 8AM

Summary:

This role will be focused on operating and maintaining dynamometer test systems for the development and validation testing of electrified powertrain systems (drive units, gearboxes). The Dyno Technician will work closely with Powertrain Test Engineers to install, configure and maintain test properties across a variety of complex powertrain test equipment in order to execute and monitor testing to requirements specified by Powertrain Validation engineers. Supported by the rest of the engineering team, you will be responsible for performing first-line troubleshooting of any operational issues encountered on test and take ownership of delivering high-quality test data to support high-level Test & Validation plans for the products.

Responsibilities:

· Operate and maintain large dynamometers (for vehicle and powertrain system level testing)

· Select and install instrumentation needed to collect response data from the product during testing (accelerometers, strain gauges, pressure gauges, thermocouples, thermistors, hygrometers, voltage drop sense leads, etc.)

· Build and setup test rigs/dynos for mechanical and/or electrical tests together with Powertrain, NVH, and Thermal engineering teams

· Perform routine maintenance to complex mechanical and electrical repairs.

· Take an active part in Environmental Heath & Safety within the laboratory environment, contributing to Risk Assessments and ensuring a safe work environment

· Support Validation Engineers to perform upgrades and modifications to Systems Under Test

· Perform the first line of fault finding for operational issues which arise on System Under Test

· Perform diagnosis and repair of prototype vehicle’s electrical/mechanical/software systems

· Support Test Engineers to achieve test plans and test equipment upgrade projects

· Document and communicate findings through processes and systems, taking ownership of early escalation where appropriate

· Generate and take ownership of process documentation for test rigs and associated test equipment

· Provide feedback, create and implement processes and suggestions to new and/or improved workshop standards, protocols, and processes.

Qualifications:

· 5+ years of Technician Experience working directly in test cells and/or large dynamometer systems

· 2+ years experience with electrified vehicles

· Expertise in instrumentation (Thermocouples, RTDs, Strain Gauges, Accelerometers, Hygrometers, Pressure Gauges, Flow Meters)

· Expertise in powertrain test setup and test error proofing

· Expertise in mechanical tooling and build fixture design

· Knowledge of motor, inverter, and gearbox concepts

· Knowledge of propulsion systems and thermal (coolant and refrigerant) systems

· Knowledge of Electric Vehicle Safety

· Work under strenuous/awkward positions throughout the working day.

· Operate a variety of scan tools, diagnostic equipment, and common automotive test equipment

· Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills to solve powertrain system issues

· Someone that takes pride in their work

· Work in a team environment and communicate with fellow technicians

· Basic workshop etiquette, provide verbal and writing communication across all teams

title: MMM
description:
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Design, build, and maintain statistical MMM models to quantify ROI across channels (HCP engagement, DTC, digital, field force, etc.).
  • Analyze impact of promotions, pricing, seasonality, payer dynamics, and regulatory constraints on product performance.
  • Translate complex model outputs into clear business insights and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with MMM lead in the team to align MMM with business strategy.
  • Handle multi-country / multi-brand datasets, ensuring consistency in modeling frameworks across geographies.
  • Integrate omnichannel data sources (CRM, media spend, claims, prescriptions, digital engagement, etc.).
  • Conduct scenario planning and optimization to guide marketing allocation and budget decisions.
  • Continuously improve MMM methodologies by incorporating advanced analytics techniques (Bayesian models, causal inference).
Required Qualifications
  • 6+ years of experience in Marketing Mix Modeling analytics.
  • Hands-on experience in Healthcare, Pharma, or Medical Devices industry (mandatory).
  • Strong expertise in regression modeling, time-series analysis, and causal inference.
  • Proficiency in Python/R (statsmodels, PyMC, Prophet, scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experience working with large-scale, messy datasets (claims, prescription, healthcare provider data).
  • Deep understanding of healthcare marketing channels (HCP promotion, field force, digital, patient marketing).
  • Proven ability to present complex insights to non-technical business stakeholders.

Contract Role: Executive Assistant: Supporting Design Studio Leaders


This document outlines the scope of work for the Contract Role Executive Assistant supporting the Design Studio Leaders.


Leaders Supported:


● Chief Design Officer: Main, Full Support


● Sr. Director, Exterior Design: Light Support


● Senior Director, UI/UX Design: Light Support


● TBD - Pending additional light support for other leaders for cross functional requests- only when they need to meet with other senior leaders, very rare.



Scope of Role:


Supporting Chief Design Officer (CDO) - Full Support.


The Executive Assistant (EA) is the "heartbeat of the studio", serving as a critical hub for operations and communication. This role requires responding to urgent tasks and ensuring CDO is kept informed of daily, weekly, and monthly changes. You will thrive in a fast-paced, upbeat environment with a fun organization and coworkers. While CDO has an operational team to prioritize his schedule on a weekly basis, this role will focus on monitoring and adjusting his schedule to accommodate everyday changes as needed.


Core Responsibilities & Studio Environment:


● Communication Gateway: Keeping design leaders and Operations Team (Core Group that helps Jeff) and Jeff in contact.


● Urgent Response: Responding to urgent tasks and keeping everyone looped into changes.


● Onboarding: Calendar will already be set up; you will mirror the current EA for one month prior to her maternity leave to learn the day-to-day operations.


● Studio Culture: Fun, upbeat environment with fun coworkers.


● Required Attitude: Resilient professional with strong cross-functional communication skills and a proactive approach to navigating ambiguous or fast-paced environments.


● Hours: Studio Core Hours are 9 AM–5 PM, but available via text with Jeff for urgent items when needed.


● Travel/WFH: Travel is not required. WFH days are optional on CDO’s travel days (typically Mondays and additional days based on the week).



Calendar & Scheduling Management


● Provide Full Calendar Support.


● Gatekeeper: Leaders will only come to you for scheduling meetings with CDO, whose schedule is back-to-back.


● Priority Alignment: Work with four Operations support staff to align on priority meetings each week, presenting them to Jeff together on Tuesdays.


● Schedule Adjustment: Role is to shift and adjust CDO’s schedule as needed for urgent cross-functional meetings and to keep up with CEO meetings that shift.


● Categorization: Labels will be created on Gmail Calendar for Weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly meetings, plus recurring CEO meetings, to help you schedule properly.


● Proactive Management: Text CDO and the Support Team when meetings are running long or to get CDO to his next meeting when he is running late. He will come ASAP when texted.


Administrative & Inbox Support


● Travel Arrangements: Use the NAVAN *** System to update flights if things shift and arrange any travel needs to other *** locations.


o Note: CDO's Monday Palo Alto trips and rental cars will already be booked.


● Expense Reports: Submit to the Coupa system on the last week of the month for the corporate card (used for CSO’s lunches and some office supplies).


● Inbox Support (Minimal): Schedule any meetings CDO needs with people outside of ***.


o CEO Coordination: Communication with the Office of the CEO and other Senior Leader EAs to move Jeff’s schedule daily to work around the CEO’s changing schedule.


o Tags: Tags on the Inbox (To Read ASAP, Updates, and To Approve) are already set up.


● Design Agendas: Update Excel Agendas for recurring Design Reviews by adding agendas the day before the review so attendees can review beforehand.


● Minimal Note Taking: Take Notes at Weekly Leader Staff meeting and Monthly Full Leader Staff Meeting, brief notes and will have a Deck to work off of that is already set up, send notes to Leaders for recap after meeting (I take notes on my phone and run them through Gemini for ease to make them brief)


● Contact Coordination: The current EA will provide a list of all Senior Leaders Jeff works with, their EAs, and contacts for specific tasks (Travel, Events, Catering, Office of the CEO, Facilities). I will create a handbook with all Facts/Q&A’s for ease!



Day-to-Day In-Studio Support


● Morning Routine: Greet CDO with coffee in the AM based on his start time (free at the *** Coffee Shop).


● Lunch: Help get CDO’s lunch from the cafe when he is in person, expensing it to the provided corporate credit card (only done when CDO is in person).


● End-of-Day Recap: Send an End-of Day Recap to CDO M-TH to keep him on track regarding any changes, upcoming travel, and CEO meetings shifted/changed.



Studio Events & Visitors


● Event Coordination: On occasion, work with the catering team to help organize studio events for food and beverage.


● Visitor Management:


o Greet VIP Guests coming into the Studio.


o Have VIP Guests sign into the lobby and sign an NDA for entry into the Design Studio (it is badge access only since Advanced Work/Designs are located within it).


● Team Support: Join a Slack channel used by EAs to support each other and update/communicate leadership travel and meetings.

title: Sales Enablement Associate
description:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly collaborative and strategic Sales Enablement Associate to drive the adoption, optimization, and success of our core sales technology stack across our global markets.

In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between our central development teams and our regional/country sales teams. You will own the end-to-end user experience for three primary platforms, ensuring that market-specific feature requirements are understood, issues are swiftly resolved, and sales teams are fully equipped to leverage these tools to drive retail execution and business intelligence.
The Tool Portfolio
You will be the global champion and primary liaison for the following critical systems:
  • OneHub: Our end-to-end store and visit management platform used by sales teams for sales tracking, Retail Sales Associate (RSA) training, in-store execution, and merchandising audits.
  • OneDash: Our centralized Business Intelligence (BI) and AI dashboard that provides actionable business insights to global and regional leadership.
  • Salesforce / GFA: The primary tool used for RSA surveys and field data collection in specific operational countries.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Adoption & Field Enablement
  • Lead the global rollout and continuous adoption strategies for OneHub, OneDash, and Salesforce/GFA across various country markets.
  • Conduct comprehensive product demos, onboarding sessions, and continuous "handholding" for both new and existing country teams.
  • Develop training materials, best-practice playbooks, and localized use-case guides to ensure sales teams are maximizing the value of the tools.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Act as the primary liaison between Central Operations, Product/Development teams, and Regional/Country Sales leadership.
  • Facilitate day-to-day working sessions with global stakeholders to ensure alignment on tool usage, operational goals, and reporting standards.
  • Navigate cultural and operational differences across regions to standardize processes while accommodating critical local market needs.
Product Feedback & Feature Lifecycle
  • Conduct continuous discovery with country teams to deeply understand their operational challenges, product feature requirements, and UI/UX needs.
  • Translate field feedback into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories for the development teams.
  • Participate in sprint planning and product roadmap discussions to advocate for the regional teams' most pressing needs.
Issue Resolution & Support
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for critical system issues, bugs, and workflow blockers reported by country teams.
  • Partner closely with technical support and development teams to ensure timely resolution of issues, communicating status updates transparently back to the field.
Qualifications & Experience
  • Global Experience (Required): Proven track record working in a global or multi-regional role, with demonstrated success managing and influencing international stakeholders across different time zones and cultures.
  • Professional Background: 5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Product Operations, Sales Operations, or a Customer Success/Adoption role—ideally within the retail, consumer goods, or tech sectors.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong familiarity with CRM software (Salesforce), BI/Analytics dashboards, and retail execution/field sales applications.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple overlapping rollouts, feature requests, and support tickets simultaneously without losing attention to detail.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication. You must be able to translate complex technical concepts into simple, actionable terms for field sales teams, and conversely, translate field business needs into technical requirements for developers.
  • Empathetic Problem Solver: A high degree of patience and empathy when "handholding" users through new technologies, coupled with a proactive approach to solving their day-to-day challenges.

Provides day-to-day NAND Lab support across all assigned tool sets.

Adheres to and applies safety procedures within Lab environment.
Performs/supports safety audits routinely and manages hazardous/chemical supplies as necessary according to site safety, local or state requirements.
Experienced executing operational steps necessary on Advantest M67xxAD automated Handler and Advantest Tester systems.
Experienced executing operational steps necessary on Teradyne Nextest Magnum Tester systems in a Windows and User Interface environment.

Uses Lab workflow tools supporting the movement of material from incoming to outgoing.
Tracks Interface hardware within an inventory management system.
Troubleshoots and resolves standard and non-standard hardware and software problems.
Provide training on test equipment & tooling for test development users as needed.
Plans and participates with Management & Finance supporting Lab material forecasting with focus on cost reduction opportunities.
Test Equipment experienced required. Examples include Advantest Test Equipment knowledge; overall Testers for Memory applications – Teradyne Magnum Testers; Advantest Testers including B6700, V93K, T5835 & legacy handlers – M67xx series.
Experienced in the Application use of Microsoft Office Products Suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

title: Senior Software Simulation Engineer
description:
Job Title: Simulation Engineer (DES)


Job Title: Simulation Engineer, Factory Design
Work location: Remote
Working hours: 40hrs/week
Travel: Yes - Must be able to travel in the first month of onboarding for 1 week to Normal, IL - additional Travel based on projects.

Role Summary


***’s Factory Design & Simulation team is seeking a contract Simulation Engineer (DES) to support early manufacturing engineering and throughput architecture for the R2 ramp in Normal.
This role focuses on building and analyzing discrete event simulation models to guide factory and line design decisions before RFQ and detailed design.
You will work closely with Body, GA, Paint, Battery, Drive Unit, and Material Flow teams to validate capacity, size buffers, and identify bottlenecks impacting R2 launch and ramp in Normal.


Key responsibilities




  • Build discrete event simulation models (FlexSim preferred) for manufacturing and material flow use cases in Normal (e.g., inter‐shop buffers, ASRS sizing, AGV flows, shop overspeed trade‐offs).




  • Translate high‐level factory requirements (demand, shift pattern, product mix, FPY, MTBF/MTTR) into simulation‐ready input assumptions and scenarios.




  • Run scenario and sensitivity studies (Experimenter) to:





    • Confirm line and shop net JPH vs. targets.




    • Quantify overspeed, OPR/TEE, and buffer requirements.




    • Evaluate jobs‐per‐shift (JPS) regularity and risk envelopes.





  • Summarize results in clear, decision‐focused reports and slide content for ME and program leadership (e.g., options with trade‐offs on throughput, risk, and space).




  • Collaborate with layout, material flow, and industrial engineering to align DES assumptions with real PORs and constraints.




  • Follow *** DES standards and libraries for model structure, naming, documentation, and handoff.




Required qualifications




  • 3+ years experience in automotive manufacturing engineering (e.g., body, paint, GA, battery, drive unit, or material flow) with direct ownership of discrete event simulation projects.




  • Expert‐level proficiency with Autodesk FlexSim




  • Demonstrated experience modeling:





    • Multi‐line assembly systems with buffers and rework.




    • Stochastic behavior (failures, repairs, variability in process times).




    • Throughput / capacity and bottleneck analysis.





  • Solid understanding of manufacturing KPIs (JPH, JPS, OEE/TEE, MTBF/MTTR, WIP, buffer sizing).




  • Ability to clean and structure input data, define scenarios, and explain model limitations and assumptions.




  • Strong communication skills: can condense complex simulation logic into concise recommendations for non‐simulation stakeholders.




Preferred qualifications




  • Familiarity with FlexScript / C++ / Python for custom logic and tooling in DES.




  • Prior work on greenfield factory design or major capacity upgrades (launch and ramp).

title: Medical Laboratory Scientist
description:
Description: JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result;
2. Maintain records that demonstrate that proficiency testing samples are tested in the same manner as patient specimens;
3. Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures (see department SOPs).
4. Review and release test results.
5. Follow CLIA, HIPAA, OSHA, and safety guidelines as described in their respective guidelines.
6. Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies, document all quality control activities, instrument and procedural calibrations and all maintenance performed;
7. Follow the laboratory's established policies and procedures whenever test systems are not within the laboratory's established acceptable levels of performance.
8. Identify problems that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results, correct the problems encountered or immediately notify the senior technologist or supervisor.
9. Document all corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the laboratory's established performance specifications.
10. Follow department's procedure in reporting STATS or Critical results to clients.
11. If applicable, answer questions from customers or other lab personnel.
12. Maintain complete records of all testing performed on-site.
13. Maintain general appearance of the department.
14. Make sure reagents/test kits have received dates, expiration dates, and if applicable opened dates. 15. Review/train on new procedures.
16. Attend monthly department and any additional training/educational meetings.
17. Participate in all applicable safety training sessions. Know the location and contents of the safety manual. Know the location/use of all applicable safety equipment.
18. If needed, participate in government or regulatory agency inspections.
19. Perform other duties as directed by supervisor.
Required Knowledge: A solid understanding of basic laboratory testing is required for this position. The successful candidate must possess good computer skills and be able to adapt to working in multiple computer systems. Must have knowledge of QC and QA as well as knowledge of all areas of the laboratory.

Education:
BS in Medical Technology preferred; or BS/BA in Chemistry or Biology, or Associates degree in a Laboratory Science or Medical Technology, or Previously qualified as a Technologist under 42 CFR 493. 1433 published in March 14, 1990. Foreign educated candidates must provide a detailed credential evaluation from IERF (International Education Research Foundation). United States educated candidates must provide a detailed original transcript. A successful candidate should possess or be eligible for national certification as an MT / MLT from a recognized organization (ASCP or AMT).
Work Experience:
1 year Clinical experience (high complexity testing) preferred. Minimum of 1 year of clinical laboratory experience in highly complex testing for those with BS/BA in Chemistry or Biology. National and State licensure as required.
Special Requirements:
1. Must have the ability to establish work priorities and handle several procedures simultaneously.
2. Must interact with other departments.
3. Contact with clients may be required, good customer service skills are important.
4. Must protect patient confidentiality at all times.
